summary: Wellchange Holdings Company Limited, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement along with related proxy cards. The EGM, set for October 29, 2026 in Hong Kong, will consider a one-for-ten consolidation of Class A ordinary shares, increasing par value from US$0.000025 to US$0.00025, plus adoption of amended articles. A separate Class B meeting must approve the variation of Class B rights. The board urges votes FOR. This is a routine capital-structure/meeting matter, not a special situation.
